scope: Export in the editor toolbars looked enabled on every Disabled screen. Vidra Fresh / Toolbar / Editor (2090:87882) and Vidra Fresh / Toolbar / Mobile editor (1819:6506) place Export as Vidra Fresh / Button (1959:7702) Tone=Primary, but their definitions override its fill to toolbar/primary (#f7f7f7) and its label to surface/canvas (#111111). Every screen that switched Export to Disabled or Loading had also frozen its own copy of those overrides. Both layers of pins were removed, so Export now takes every colour from its Button state.
approach: Read-only census first on all 20 pages: every fill or stroke bound to toolbar/primary, and every instance of the two editor toolbars with its Export state, label, fills, screen-level overrides, prototype links and the surface behind it. The census went into a scratchpad ledger before any write.

toolbar/primary (VariableID:1993:699) was bound only by the two definitions' Export instances and by screen-level copies of those overrides. No other toolbar or control uses it, so the overrides were removed instead of keeping the token for the enabled look.

Definitions: removeOverrides on Export, then every override except the two colours was re-applied: layer name, Label, hug width, 28px height, radius/small corners and the Inter Regular 12 label. Add, Captions and History in the same toolbars use that size and type, so it was kept.

Screens: an Export that a screen switched to another state keeps its own frozen copy of the definition's overrides, so the definition fix alone did not reach it. Each of the 22 switched Exports was reset with removeOverrides and given back its recorded tone, state, label, name and links. On the state change Figma copied the definition's size and type overrides again, now without fills.
Writes were one definition or one page at a time, each verified in the same script against the recorded state, label, size, typography, name and links. E22 was done alone first to prove the method.
Application code is out of scope. This record is the only repository file added; no existing record was edited.
